name: Yamaguchi
source:
One of the younger nurses. She is an ex-delinquent as her looks indicate, She is outspoken and quick with her hands.

She has a reasonable personality and is not a bad human being.  In fact, some say she is the most decent person in the hospital.

[From [url=https://nexton-net.jp/ms-toybox/darkone/sakuseibyoto3/character/index.html]official site[/url]]
